findings.title: Recorded Future Insikt Group: BlueDelta Targets Defense and Diplomacy with HOOKEDGE
findings.summary_md: Recorded Future's Insikt Group disclosed HOOKEDGE, a webhook-based backdoor linked to BlueDelta (APT28), in an August 27, 2026 report. The malware targets defense and diplomatic organizations across Europe. The disclosure documented code overlap with HEADLACE, a modular Windows backdoor previously used by APT28. Campaigns spanned from September 2025 through early April 2026.

findings.title: APT28-Linked HOOKEDGE Backdoor Targets European Government and Diplomatic Organizations
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported on August 29, 2026 that Recorded Future linked HOOKEDGE campaigns to APT28 with moderate confidence. The campaigns targeted government and diplomatic organizations in Romania, Spain, and Turkey between late September 2025 and early April 2026. Confirmed infections included malicious Microsoft Word attachments.
